newsitem.title: UK: LME copper up in late London, flirts with $2,600.
newsitem.headline: LME copper up in late London, flirts with $2,600.

text.p: LME copper edged up in late inter-office activity after spending Monday taking a rest after attacking the $2,600 per tonne mark last week.
Third Wednesday pricing during the morning rings failed to spark much excitement and three month copper finished the afternoon kerb little changed at $2,588, down $2 from Friday.
Later when COMEX closed at 1800 GMT three-months LME copper was indicated just shy of $2,600 at $2,597.
But some analysts say the market is still overbought and may have trouble rechallenging last week's $2,609 peak in the near-term.
